All praise and thanks be to Allah, and peace be upon His chosen
bondsmen and women!

text: The Qur'an is the final revealed Book that contains the message of guidance from Allah for all humankind.

The Qur'an is the final revealed Book that contains the message of
guidance from Allah for all humankind.

text: Accordingly, the salvation as well as worldly welfare of the entire humanity depends upon following the guidance ordained in this Divine Book.
text_raw:
Accordingly, the salvation as
well as worldly welfare of the entire humanity depends upon following the
guidance ordained in this Divine Book.

text: In other words, success in this world as well as the Hereafter for humankind is treasured in this great Book.
text_raw:
In other words, success in this
world as well as the Hereafter for humankind is treasured in this great
Book.

text: Therefore, there is an endless need to compile Qur'anic expositions (in the context of modern challenges and evolving circumstances) while calling people towards understanding its eternal message.
text_raw:

(in the context of modern challenges and evolving circumstances) while
calling people towards understanding its eternal message.

text: Indeed, blessed are those who have been given the opportunity to serve the Qur'an in one way or another, and more so if the effort receives general acceptance among the public.
